reviews.text: Excellent 24-hour service. Several tests available. Good doctors.

Gaya received exceptional care, and we were very well received, welcomed, and given clear explanations. A 10 out of 10 service.

DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS TO THIS CLINIC! This week my 2-month-old puppy was in pain and, desperate, I went to the nearest clinic to have him examined (unfortunately, this clinic), and it was one of the most distressing days of my life. First, the veterinarian injected him with two medications, and a few hours later, when we were already home, he SEIZURED because he had an allergic reaction to one of them. I rushed him back to the clinic, and she administered diazepam, which had another unexpected effect: he became hyper-agitated, barking nonstop and in despair instead of sleeping. And the worst part... the lack of support from the only two employees present at the clinic (the veterinarian and another staff member) was appalling. He was thrashing around the whole time, barking excessively, and they simply sat there as if nothing was happening. It was a complete lack of preparedness from beginning to end, from administering these medications for the first time to a 2-month-old puppy without knowing how it would react, and then, after it convulsed, having this irresponsibility in fully monitoring the little animal. It was extreme negligence that could have cost him his life; it was serious, it was traumatizing. On top of that, the clinic's lack of preparedness is so blatant because instead of trying to improve, they respond to negative comments claiming people are lying... it's absurd. It's as if everyone has free time to negatively review things here for pure entertainment? It's shameful, it's complete disregard. DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS TO THIS CLINIC UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES, IT COULD COST THEIR LIVES!!!!!!!! Don't take them, for God's sake, people. And if you respond negatively, I don't care; what interests me is warning pet owners not to go through what I went through, or even much worse.
I like INPA, which has always helped with my pets' emergencies. The receptionist Márcia provided quick service, and Dr. Arthur was careful and loving with my dog.
Excellent service and qualified professionals.

The person in charge didn't know how to handle a pet owner who had been treating her with them, trying to figure out what was wrong with her pet. Surgery was scheduled for Wednesday, June 17th, and canceled at 9 PM on June 15th due to broken equipment. Yes, I called, angry and frustrated, because the surgery would have to be postponed by 7 or 10 days. I wanted another option. He said I was arguing with him. He felt "personally attacked." He said he treated Brisa very well, and yes, he did, but then he said, "Oh, but I went there today to treat Brisa and do the blood test with the special tube, etc." rs as if it were an obligation? Something that was scheduled? Then today (June 16th) the gastroenterologist who was with him called me to say that he didn't like it and that he doesn't want to treat Brisa at his clinic anymore. Oh my god! Is this fifth grade? Maybe it's better this way. I mean, really. Ridiculous, basically denying the treatment we've been receiving for at least 3 months. A joke. I don't recommend it. And now, basically, what the owner is doing is denying Brisa any treatment she needs someday, since he no longer wants to treat her at his clinic. Very good, congratulations.

INPA is wonderful. Dr. Hugo, an excellent surgeon and dentist, Dr. Arthur, a specialist in cats and also dogs, Dr. Alexandre, and others. ALL great veterinarians. I've been going there with my animals for over 30 years.
Excellent service! Great professionals. Safety and care for my cats. I recommend them!

Terrible experience!!

Our dog had an intestinal infection, was hospitalized, stayed for less than 24 hours, where we spent over 2,000 reais. No antibiotics were given, only medication for pain and vomiting. But the worst part was the blood test that showed the presence of microfilariae (heartworm), and no professional informed us about it, nor did they prescribe any treatment, and we know how serious this disease is, it can kill!!! In addition, it took weeks for them to send the ultrasound report, even after our request.

In short, I do not recommend them, unfortunately we cannot trust them!!

Thank God our pet is doing well, undergoing treatment for Dirofilariasis and being monitored by a trusted professional.

I took my cat Salem to this clinic for medication and saw that they are professionals. Before, I took him to the one in Botafogo, in Real Grandeza, which they say is popular, but it's only popular in name. They did many tests on my cat and said he needed a blood test, but in reality, this clinic did everything and my cat is healthy. Thank you for existing.

My name is Laís, I was with my kitten named Gon at INPA, and I was extremely well taken care of. Dr. Arthur is an incredible veterinarian who treated me with all the patience and concern in the world. He really wanted to find out what my cat had and he succeeded. I had already hospitalized my cat with another veterinarian who didn't find anything and discharged him. At INPA, Dr. Arthur ordered all the correct and accurate tests to discover that my cat has FIP. My cat was hospitalized there in bad shape and was discharged much better and with the correct medications. We are doing the treatment and, God willing, we will overcome this disease.
If I could give 1000 stars I would, the clinic is wonderful and everyone who works there is very professional and attentive. I will definitely recommend it to everyone! I just have to thank you 🙏🏼❤️✨
The care my dog ​​received from INPA was excellent ❤️

I have nothing but praise for all the professionals at INPA. My dog, Paçoca, needed veterinary care, exams, and procedures. She was treated like a princess, and we received the best attention from all the INPA staff.

Last Thursday, in a moment of great anguish and fragility, I sought out an emergency clinic without even knowing exactly where to begin. It was through Google that I found the INPA Clinic—and I can say, with absolute certainty, that it was an encounter filled with great care and humanity.

I arrived with my Martina (my Lulua), who had been unwell for three days, and without knowing exactly what was happening. From the moment I arrived, I was welcomed with care, attention, and sensitivity. Dr. Ramon treated us in an extremely humane, welcoming, and efficient manner. The diagnosis of hemorrhagic gastroenteritis was made quickly, as was the immediate start of treatment, which gave me a great sense of security during such a delicate time.

Martina was hospitalized from Thursday to Sunday, and throughout that period, I maintained constant contact with the clinic. Every single day, without exception, I was treated with great affection, attention, and availability. I received clear information, frequent updates, and always with great respect for my emotional state—something that made all the difference.

Dr. Ramon, in particular, was always available, even via message, bringing peace of mind, explaining Martina's condition, treatment, and progress in a very careful and humane way.

On Friday morning, Martina had an ultrasound, and was very well attended to by Dr. Hugo and the doctor who accompanied him (unfortunately I don't remember her name), both extremely attentive, careful, and clear in their explanations during that very sensitive moment.

I leave this experience with profound gratitude. Gratitude for the technical care, the speed, the competence, but mainly for the welcoming, the empathy, and the affection with which my four-legged daughter was treated—and me as well.

Martina is doing well, she continues her recovery, and I have no doubt: INPA Clinic is a place I trust completely. I will return, not in an emergency, but with the certainty that I have found the clinic where she will have her routine check-ups, consultations, and exams.

My deepest, deepest, deepest thanks to the entire team 💛🐶

Some of the staff have absolutely no desire to serve the public. I called to ask about the X-ray hours, and the attendant literally gave me ALL the wrong times. If it wasn't on purpose, it's a serious, serious lack of training.

A butcher shop. After numerous consultations where my cat was evaluated by more than one professional, it was decided that she would undergo tartar removal and tooth extraction surgery, which cost approximately 5,000 reais, including exams, hospitalization, etc. This is in addition to the money spent on the consultations that led to the decision for surgery. During the surgery, they discovered a huge tumor on the cat's tongue, a possibility never even raised during the numerous consultations. Even so, they performed the surgery unnecessarily. Furthermore, during the post-operative period I received very little support and even had experiences like paying 545 reais for a convenia application, among other applications, where I was never informed of the price beforehand. I will never set foot on the sidewalk of that place again, and if you care about and respect your pet, you should do the same. The owner's response below is truly unbelievable. The cat's illness had no concrete connection whatsoever with the issue raised in previous consultations, and the individual is still trying to hold me, as the pet owner, responsible for what happened to the animal. There were three consultations in the two weeks leading up to the procedure. The cat's mouth was opened by more than one professional; it was analyzed how many teeth needed to be removed; the "lump" under the tongue, as your employee called it, was observed. And as I said, the surgery was still performed. There is no untruth. It is simply a summary of a place where the pursuit of profit speaks louder. I appreciate the laughable satisfaction given only after a public statement.

My cat was hospitalized and passed away at this place two weeks ago. I have no complaints about the treatment she received, but with me, the approach was always brusque and there was always a clear rush to receive payments. The impression I get is that they only spoke politely and only paid attention to that aspect.
I think it's disrespectful to pet owners who are stressed and worried. Even giving information and explaining my cat's condition was rude, especially the night shift staff! ZERO tact, care, and politeness towards pet owners.
My cat arrived Thursday night, already showing signs that she didn't want to eat, and they took a long time to put in the feeding tube. In addition, they did several tests and didn't know her diagnosis, and even now, after she passed away, there's no explanation of exactly what she had.
This clinic is completely unhumanized. Even now that I'm only contacting them to get information about my cat's cremation, they don't care at all, since I've already paid. So, pet owners, if you're going to take your animals there, be aware that they don't mind being rude.

I want to leave my statement here to the veterinary surgeon Bárbara, who carefully inserted the catheter into my cat and was an EXAMPLE of politeness with me, and to Dr. Hugo, who was very helpful and quick to schedule her surgery, VERY different from the other professionals I had contact with.
Excellent professionals. I highly recommend going to an ophthalmologist.
